title: Server backups
description: Snapshots of the server structure: roles, categories, channels and permissions. If someone (or a compromised account) tears the server apart, you can bring it back with one click.
needsUpdate: Backups need bot version 8.4 or newer — update the bot.
saveText: The bot saves the server's current structure. The latest 10 backups are kept per server.
saving: The bot is backing up the server…
autoText: When enabled, the bot backs up daily — but only if the structure changed.
safeText: The bot deletes nothing: it only creates the missing roles, categories and channels, and saves the current state first. “Preview” shows exactly what will happen.
fixPermissions: Also restore permissions on existing channels
fixPermissionsText: If someone changed access, it's reset to the saved state (for channels not synced to their category).
emptyEdit: Create one above — best do it now, while everything is fine.
previewing: The bot is comparing the backup with the server…
restoring: The bot is restoring the server…
restoreText: The bot will create the missing roles, categories and channels. Nothing is deleted.
restoreTextFix: The bot will create the missing roles, categories and channels, and reset existing channels' permissions to the saved state. Nothing is deleted.
deleteText: The backup will be deleted permanently.
